services.name: Charter Trips
services.desc: Our blue water big game charters are available March - May and August - November. These trips can be booked as a private charter with just your group on board, or as a walk-on style in which you just pay for the number of fishermen in your party and we find the rest of the fishermen needed to round out the trip. Only 10 fishermen are allowed on these trips aboard the Lady Ann or 11 fishermen on the Escape. So even if you choose the walk-on style trip, there is still plenty of room on board for everyone. Trips range from short 6-hour bottom fishing to multi-day bluewater walk-on trips. The business is family owned and operated with experienced captains.
